item.title: Undertone 1.31.0
item.description:
• Undertone Business: Pro for everyone on your team. Admins start it from Settings › Team, pick how many seats, and check out through Paddle. Everyone with a seat gets Pro on their own.
  • Settings › Team shows seats used, when the plan renews and who doesn't have a seat yet. Admins can add or remove seats there.
  • A Business badge on the Team page.

Undertone 1.30.0

  • Onboarding guides now write in the background. Close the window and keep working; a spinner in Guides shows it's writing, and you get a notification when the draft is ready to review.
  • Share a guide by link: anyone with the link can read it in a browser. Links last 7 days, 30 days or until you turn them off.
  • Up next shows your Mac calendar right away and checks Google Calendar quietly in the background.

Undertone 1.29.0

  • Onboarding guides: on the Team page, Undertone writes a guide for new teammates from your team glossary, shared recaps and org chart. Edit it, share it with the team, and anyone can read, edit or copy it.
  • Choose which team news shows as Mac notifications: mentions, comments, assignments, finished action items and new guides (Settings › Team).

Undertone 1.28.0

  • A new Team page: what needs you, the notes your team shared, upcoming meetings with teammates, who's on the team with their titles, the org chart, the team glossary and your automations, all on one page.
  • Up next shows right away: it no longer waits for Google Calendar, which now refreshes quietly in the background.

Undertone 1.27.0

  • Workspaces are now separate accounts: each has its own meetings, settings, AI keys and plan.
  • Add a workspace by signing in with another Google, Microsoft or email account, and switch between them without restarting.
  • Team features follow the account of the workspace you're in.

  • Team glossary. Your workspace keeps one list of its own terms, acronyms and project names. Hints explain them the same way for everyone and transcription spells them right. Find it under Glossary › Team, or right-click any term to add it.
